Here's a summary of what was implemented:

### Files created/modified

| File | Purpose |
|------|---------|
| `TicketClassifier.csproj` | Added `Microsoft.ML 4.0.2` + CSV copy rule |
| `Models/TicketData.cs` | ML.NET input/output data classes |
| `Models/TicketRequest.cs` | API DTOs: request, prediction response, evaluation metrics |
| `Services/TicketClassifierService.cs` | ML pipeline: text featurization → SDCA MaxEntropy classifier |
| `Controllers/TicketController.cs` | Two endpoints (see below) |
| `Program.cs` | Registers classifier as singleton |

### Endpoints

- **`POST /api/ticket/classify`** — Accepts `{ subject, description, priority }`, returns predicted category + confidence scores per class
- **`GET /api/ticket/metrics`** — Returns evaluation metrics (micro/macro accuracy, log loss, per-category precision/recall/F1)

### ML Pipeline

Text features from Subject and Description are featurized and concatenated with Priority, then fed into an **SDCA Maximum Entropy** multiclass classifier. The model trains at startup from `Data/tickets.csv` with a 70/30 train/test split.

> **Note:** Metrics show low accuracy because the training CSV only has 6 rows. Adding more labeled data will significantly improve results.
